text: dsh-quote-followup（DSH Web 插件）：选中对话内容并将其引用到输入框，便于围绕具体片段追问。它在 Web 对话文本选中后显示浮动引用按钮，通过当前会话的输入接口插入原生引用 chip；发送时 codec 将 chip 转为 Markdown 引用块，缺少原生能力时使用纯文本。支持连续引用、显示角色和可用轮次信息，并在输入框不可用时提示重试。适合需要针对长对话中的某段内容继续提问的 DSH Web 用户。需要将插件加入 Web profile 并重启服务。

Quote selected DSH Web text in the composer for focused follow-ups. A floating button inserts a reference chip in the active session; sending expands it into a Markdown quote. Older hosts use plain text, with role and turn context when available. Add the plugin to the Web profile and restart DSH.
想把 DSH 网页对话里选中的一段文字放进输入框，再围绕它继续提问。
能不能引用聊天中的几段内容，保留现有草稿后一起追问？
我想针对长对话中的某个回答追问，不想手动复制粘贴。
让 DSH Web 把选中的消息片段变成发送时可读的引用块。
How can I quote a passage from a DSH Web conversation into my draft?
I want to ask a follow-up about selected chat text without copying it manually.
dsh-quote-followup 的功能「引用选中文本」：用户在 Web 对话区选中文本后，浮动按钮出现在选区附近；点击后将摘录追加到当前输入框。
dsh-quote-followup 的功能「原生引用 chip」：插件通过当前会话的输入接口插入紧凑引用 chip，发送时 codec 将其展开为带引用格式的 Markdown 文本。
dsh-quote-followup 的功能「纯文本降级」：当原生 codec 或会话输入能力不可用时，将格式化引用作为文本追加到 textarea 或编辑器。
Localized action: the floating Quote button follows DSH locale, with English fallback.
DSH 老是要我手动搬运上下文，有办法把选中的原文直接带进追问吗？
Can I turn a selected passage into a quote in my DSH Web draft?

dsh-quote-followup README · dsh-quote-followup：English | [中文](README.zh.md) [](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-quote-followup) [](LICENSE) [](https://dsh.market/) A Web-only [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) plugin for quoting selected conversation text into the composer and asking a focused follow-up.

dsh-quote-followup README · dsh-quote-followup：

Select. Quote. Follow up.

dsh-quote-followup README · Features：- Select text inside the Web conversation transcript to reveal a floating **Quote** button.
- Append a native DSH conversation-reference chip without replacing the existing draft, using the session-scoped composer input facade rather than Lexical's private node registry.
- Reuse the same atomic `ReferenceChipNode`, conversation icon, and business color as `@file` / `@session`.
- Keep each chip compact by showing only the excerpt; the bubble icon already conveys that it is a quote.
- Follow the active DSH locale for the floating action and serialized quote frame.
- Attach the conversation turn number to the serialized frame when both ends of the selection belong to the same DSH chat row. Selections spanning messages keep the excerpt but omit ambiguous role/turn provenance.
- Quote multiple excerpts; on send, the plugin codec expands each chip into a model-readable Markdown blockquote.
- Resolve the active session through the DSH 0.1.7 UI session adapter, while retaining the older session-list selection path; never paste an unscoped quote when no session binding is available.
- Fall back to a plain-text quote when the host lacks native chip suppor
dsh-quote-followup README · Features：TUI is intentionally unsupported.

dsh-quote-followup README · Scope：This is a Web client-side extension. The composer and send path are owned by the browser client: chips exist only in the Lexical editor, and the model only ever sees the Markdown blockquotes the codec expands at send time — never the chips themselves. No host-side plugin surface is involved.

dsh-quote-followup README · Scope：Chips are text-only by design. They carry the excerpt, a display-only role hint, the conversation turn ordinal when it is available, and a truncation flag — no global session-message references — so they stay valid across compaction folds and session rotation.

dsh-quote-followup README · Install：Requires DSH `>=0.1.2-rc.1`.

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-quote-followup
```

Add `dsh-quote-followup` to the Web profile's `dsh.profile.bundles`, then restart `dsh web` so the server rebuilds its boot-time client bundle. Reload or reopen browser tabs that stayed open across the restart; their already-loaded JavaScript cannot update itself from a new server process.

dsh-quote-followup README · Use：1. Select text in a conversation message.
2. Click **❐ Quote**.
3. Select and quote more excerpts if needed.
4. Type the follow-up after the inserted chips and send.

dsh-quote-followup README · Development：```bash
npm test
```

The regression harness covers modern and legacy session selection, absent selection/binding, compact native quote chips, locale switching, single-row versus cross-message provenance, missing/locked composer feedback and retry, repeated quoting, spacing after an existing draft, codec serialization, the Firefox text fallback, and current-client takeover of stale singleton/button state after a hot swap.

dsh-quote-followup README · Development：An opt-in [assembled DSH Web regression](https://github.com/tr1v3r/dsh-quote-followup/blob/master/test/integration/README.md) runs the plugin through a pinned, built DSH checkout with Chromium. It covers existing drafts, repeated quoting, undo/redo, session isolation, prompt serialization, and Host-driven unavailable input.
